desc: Ideate approaches and select a 26-letter DP over target frequency.
Derive that same-letter cost is 0, adjacent upward change saves 1 versus delete+insert, and all other reassignments cost 2.
Implement frequency counts and the two-state DP for each target frequency f=1..len(s) with the node/edge costs above.
Test the implementation on the provided examples and edge cases such as all 'z', all same letters, zero-count letters, and insertion-heavy cases.
